videos.headline: Highlight: Alabama's season ends with Rose Bowl loss to Indiana
videos.description: The No. 9 Crimson Tide see their season come to a close with a 38-3 loss to Indiana in the Rose Bowl, finishing the year with 11 wins and a CFP quarterfinal appearance.

videos.headline: Indiana's Charlie Becker toe-taps for a 30-yard gain
videos.description: Fernando Mendoza throws a pass to the sideline for Charlie Becker, who is able to get a toe down for a 30-yard gain.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Indiana's Charlie Becker toe-taps for a 30-yard gain) 2026/01/01 ESHEET

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Nico Radicic makes a 31-yard FG to get Indiana on the board) 2026/01/01 ESHEET
